name: navigator-task-cadence-decision
body:
Decision record for the navigator-task-cadence change-set.

SOURCE. Observed in the just-merged `agent-fs-tools` change-set: the binary's staleness guard refuses every plan/review mutation unless the branch graph's recorded HEAD matches the working tree (same sha and clean). The navigator prompt's "Implementation flow" text (lines ~452-461) told the implementer to mark tasks done (`apg_plan_done`) and "commits at phase end" — an ordering the guard makes impossible: marking done after the commit is stale (the recorded HEAD lags the new commit), and marking done before/while dirty is refused (clean required).

INCONSISTENCY / RESOLUTION. The prompt text contradicted the shipped guard (`rust.apg.git.state.is_fresh`; refusal via `rust.apg.git.state.refusal_message`; the mutation gate is `rust.apg.artifacts.db.write_jsonl_and_reingest` for the plan/review surface and `rust.apg.layers.write.write_project_with` for node/edge). Resolution: document the per-task cadence — implementer commits and returns; the coordinator quick-verifies, scans, then resumes the session to mark done. A target-less task needs no commit/scan; aggregates are ordered after their units, gates last.

SPEC AUTHORING. Added `requirements.user.navigator-agent` (the coordinator actor — no existing navigator/coordinator user or stakeholder existed; checked users and stakeholders), `requirements.requirement.navigator-task-cadence` (feature `navigator-task-cadence`), the domain entity `domain.entity.task-execution-cadence`, and the solution component `solution.component.codebase-navigator-prompt`. Spine: user ⊃ requirement —drives→ entity —realised-by→ component —implemented-by→ `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md` (a `docs` File node, resolves in the branch graph). Added the law `requirements.constraint.navigator-cadence-stated` (attaches-to the requirement) and the `contains` edge under `solution.container.opencode-suite`.

NARROW COMPONENT. Deliberately NOT reusing the existing broad `solution.component.navigator-prompt-guidance` (already implemented-by BOTH `codebase-navigator.md` and `agent-builder.md`, and realised-by `domain.entity.graph-first-navigation`): a satisfied requirement's spine is coverage-checked (`rust.apg.plan_cmd.verify.coverage_check`), so driving the cadence requirement through the broad component would make the verify gate demand tasks over the untouched agent-builder.md. The narrow component's `implemented-by` set is exactly the one file this change-set edits — the same precedent as `solution.component.details-target-validation` (a narrow owner deliberately distinct from a broad one). [autonomous]

SCOPE. Docs-only product-source edit; the repo's own `.opencode/agents/**` are consumer artifacts and are never edited. No binary change, and no planned Implementation node is authored here (that is the plan-writer's job).
